headline: Dalmia Bharat submits postal ballot scrutinizer report and voting results
summary: Dalmia Bharat has submitted the official scrutinizer's report and voting results for its recent postal ballot to the stock exchanges. This procedural filing completes the shareholder voting process for resolutions proposed by the company. Shareholders and investors can review the outcome of the specific resolutions on the exchange portals. The filing is a standard compliance requirement with no immediate impact on stock fundamentals.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Dalmia Bharat confirms SEBI compliance on share demat and remat for Q2 FY27
hook: Routine quarterly compliance update from Dalmia Bharat
summary: Dalmia Bharat has officially confirmed its compliance with SEBI regulations regarding the dematerialisation and rematerialisation of shares for the second quarter of financial year 2027. This regulatory filing ensures procedural adherence to depository guidelines during the period. For an Indian retail investor, this routine governance filing carries no direct financial impact on stock valuations.
why_it_matters: No direct impact on stock price or your portfolio.
